threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still refer to 'the tube' as if it's your only transport option. Everyone here knows the best bus routes and the hidden bike lanes.
Sat behind two guys on the 35 who argued about the best chicken shops until one got off and yelled a 'Brixton's got the spice!' on his way out.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a guy in a suit arguing with a street musician about the best jazz record—only in Neukölln do you get that blend of chaos and culture.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you witness a techno party starting at noon on a Tuesday, with people rolling in with snacks and their kids in tow.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who’s local by how they navigate the BART delays without missing a beat. Tourists are just lost in confusion while we know the back routes.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy hop on the 21 with a parrot on his shoulder. Muni didn’t bat an eye—just another day in the ‘Loin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think 'tapas' means shared plates, but locals often prefer a quiet sit-down for a proper meal, not a snack parade.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still ask for 'tapas' instead of 'pinchos' at the bar. It's a dead giveaway in Gràcia.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused checking your Oyster card at the barriers, while the locals sail through without a second thought.
Caught a whiff of jollof rice on the 59 last night – must've been a party winding down. Nothing like late-night snacks in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a street musician playing accordion to a group of kids chasing pigeons by the canal. Classic Neukölln vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a spontaneous rave in the middle of a park on a Tuesday afternoon, complete with DJs and a massive sound system.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local by how they navigate the bus delays; they've got their own secret routes while everyone else is still waiting at the stop.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 31 Balboa, casually checking his watch as if he was heading to the Oscars. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but the locals hide in plain sight at the tiny bars on Carrer de Verdi, sipping vermut away from the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their hesitance to use the tram; they still wait for the bus instead, oblivious to the efficiency.
